comment:
* IkeUdpEncapSocket uses an {@link UdpEncapsulationSocket} to send and receive IKE packets. * *

Caller MUST provide one IkeSocketConfig when trying to get an instance of IkeUdpEncapSocket. * Each IkeSocketConfig can only be bound by one IkeUdpEncapSocket instance. When caller requests * for IkeUdpEncapSocket with an already bound IkeSocketConfig, an existing instance will be * returned.

variables.name: sConfigToSocketMap
variables.comment: Map from IkeSocketConfig to IkeSocket instances.

variables.name: mUdpEncapSocket
variables.comment: UdpEncapsulationSocket for sending and receving IKE packet.

* Get an IkeUdpEncapSocket instance. * *

Return the existing IkeUdpEncapSocket instance if it has been created for the input * IkeSocketConfig. Otherwise, create and return a new IkeUdpEncapSocket instance. * * @param sockConfig the socket configuration * @param ipsecManager for creating {@link UdpEncapsulationSocket} * @param callback the callback for signalling IkeSocket events * @return an IkeUdpEncapSocket instance
